subject: Midterm expansion & co-term alignment request
messages:
From: Kate Mullins <kate@quantixa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Midterm expansion & co-term alignment request

Markus / team,

Quick context — we've seen a faster-than-expected uptick in inference volume after the new recommendation model shipped. We're looking to add ~200k token-equivalent units/month starting Jan 1, 2027 and would prefer that any temporary top-up co-term with our existing annual renewal (Jan 31, 2027) rather than having a separate 6-month term.

Can you send:
- A pro-rated pricing option for a Jan 1 start that rolls into the Jan 31 renewal (co-term).
- A short option that shows a 6-month bridge (if co-term isn't possible) and an annualized 12-month commit option.
- Any one-time credits or bridge incentives you can offer for mid-contract expansions.

Attached is a short forecast (Quantixa_usage_forecast.xlsx) — Alex included the monthly ramp. We need this by EOD Monday so procurement can start the PO loop.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Mullins
Head of Platform, Quantixa
kate@quantixa.com

Attachment: Quantixa_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 62KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Kate Mullins <kate@quantixa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Midterm expansion & co-term alignment request

Hi Kate — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. Congrats on the ramp — always good to see product-led growth.

High-level options we can move quickly on (will follow with a short pricing spreadsheet):
1) Pro-rata + co-term: we can pro-rate Jan 1–Jan 31 usage and fold the uplift into your existing Jan 31 renewal pricing. Typical approach: pro-rate the added committed units for the 31-day window, then apply a calibrated uplift discount at renewal.
2) 6-month bridge: a temporary 6-month top-up with a 7% uplift discount on the incremental units; option to convert the remainder to the annual commit at any time with a 12% locked discount if you commit for 12 months total.
3) Bridge credit: we can offer a one-time $10k bridge credit to help offset pro-rata billing if you sign the SOW and PO before Dec 28.

I'll attach a short worksheet (redwood_uplift_pricing_v1.xlsx) with the three options and a sample invoice cadence. Ben — looping you for final price approval / escalation if we need a higher credit beyond $10k.

Next steps proposal: I can send a short SOW for the 6-month bridge + co-term clause by Monday; if you want the 12-month lock, we can price that separately.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Commercial Sales — Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_uplift_pricing_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Mullins <kate@quantixa.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Midterm expansion & co-term alignment request

Thanks Markus — looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications / firm offers from pricing:
- 12-month additional commit (adds the 200k units/month): 12% discount on incremental unit price, plus standard volume banding.
- 6-month bridge (temporary top-up): 7% discount on the incremental units for the bridge term; at conversion to the annual commit we’ll pick up the 12% effective rate from the date of conversion (no retroactive credits).
- One-time bridge credit: $10,000 if they sign SOW + PO by Dec 28. For anything beyond $10k we'll evaluate on a case-by-case basis (requires revenue lead approval).

Operational notes:
- Legal prefers to include an automatic conversion clause: if Quantixa hits 75% of the bridge capacity for two consecutive months, we automatically convert to the annualized commit pricing unless either party objects in writing. We can make that opt-out.
- Procurement path: HubSpot deal QLX-3421 is updated with the forecast and pricing worksheet — Kate / Alex, please add the PO/approver once you have it so we can set up billing.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/quantixa

If that aligns, Markus — please prepare the SOW with the chosen option and the DocuSign link.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

PS: tagging Lauren for ELA/co-term legal handoff.

From: Kate Mullins <kate@quantixa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@quantixa.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Midterm expansion & co-term alignment request

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Quantixa prefers to:
- Start the 6-month bridge Jan 1, 2027 with the 7% bridge discount,
- Take the $10k bridge credit (we can sign by Dec 27), and
- Include the conversion clause to annualize at a 12% discount if we opt to convert before the co-term.

Can you send an updated SOW that reflects: start date Jan 1, bridge pricing, the $10k credit, and the conversion-to-annual clause? Once we have the SOW and pricing grid we'll route to procurement — PO lead is me (I can sign non-disclosure, procurement needs PO for anything >$50k).

Also please provide a DocuSign link so we can accelerate.

Thanks,
Kate
